title: ubnt_poll_host.ko Downlink Scheduler (0x00b400..0x00c800 & 0x00dc38..0x00e658) & Per-Node Aggregation Budget Dissection

disassembled_functions.mechanism: Packs swr_limit (ff_dl_swr_count at 0x1c($sp), ff_ul_swr_count at 0x1d($sp), default 10/10 on Fixed Frame .82) and dispatches via ubnt_poll_host_ht_comm_tx.

Sends EVM measurement interval/config (0x1c..0x1f($sp)) to QCA988x target and resets per-station EVM sample cursor (sb $zero, 0xa4($v0)) across sta_list (0x10ec($s0)) and sta_hash_table (0x10f0($s0)).
Selectively pauses/resumes per-STA TID queues (0x1c..0x23($sp)) in QCA988x target DL/UL TDMA scheduler.
Blocks/unblocks station scheduling in target TDMA loop while checking host_data->opmode (0x118($a0)).
Encrypts/decrypts (AES-128 + HMAC-SHA1) Ubiquiti 00:27:22 Vendor IE payloads carrying station capability, priority (sta_priority 0..2), and airMAX TDMA parameters.

At 0x00c4f8..0x00c5b8 (type 6), packs 4 x 64-byte circular EVM arrays (0x40 bytes each at +0x03, +0x43, +0x83, +0xc3 -> 0x103 = 259 bytes/station stride) for host/target rate-control & linkscore evaluation.

Copies 104-byte template from .rodata, computes down_dur (0x26($sp)), up_dur (0x28($sp)), cbp_dur (0x2a($sp)), high_contention_min_down_dur (0x54($sp)=5000 us on .82), ff_unit_shift=4 (16 us quantum unit), ff_dl_swr_count=10, and sends HT_COMM netconf to target.

fields.0x5e_ff_dl_swr_count_u8: 10 software retries max per DL frame on .82
